Hero.availability: Open to full-stack and frontend opportunities
Hero.headline: Full-stack Developer with a frontend focus
Hero.description: React and TypeScript developer with commercial frontend experience and hands-on experience building full-stack applications with Next.js, Prisma and PostgreSQL. I carry features from responsive interfaces through API validation, relational data and deployment.

About.description:
Hi, I'm Xiaonan. 👋

I’m a full-stack developer with a frontend focus. My strongest tools are React and TypeScript, and I enjoy turning UI designs into responsive applications with clear state and polished interactions.

I also build features across Next.js route handlers, runtime validation, authentication and relational data using Prisma and PostgreSQL. This allows me to follow a feature from the interface through its API and database behaviour.

In my previous frontend role, I collaborated with designers, backend engineers and a mobile team. I’m looking for junior full-stack and frontend opportunities where I can contribute across the product while continuing to deepen my backend experience.
